280433603.description:
Vintage Glass Paperweight Lot - 2 Pieces
Hand-Painted Floral and Natural Mineral Inclusion
Multi-Color, Vintage
This pair of vintage glass paperweights presents two classic styles of decorative desktop art. The set includes a hand-painted floral piece with delicate white daisy motifs and a second weight featuring a collection of natural minerals encased within a clear dome. These pieces reflect the popular mid-century trend of decorative glass weights used as both functional office tools and collectible display objects.
Pieces Included:
Hand-painted paperweight, approximately 3.5 inch diameter, features white daisies and green leaves with a decorative beaded rim and green felt base.
Mineral paperweight, approximately 3 inch diameter, contains various tumbled stones including tiger's eye and turquoise-colored fragments with a green felt base.
Condition:
Both items are in excellent vintage condition. The glass is clear with no observed chips, cracks, or significant scratches. The hand-painted elements are well-preserved with no significant loss. Green felt bottoms are intact with minor shelf wear consistent with age and previous use.
Thank you for all of your support!
